  "model": "redwood-embed-xxl",

}

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 12:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sales discovery: integration recap & next steps (FinLytics)

Looping in support 1 I kicked off a quick repro in staging using your approximate payload and were able to reproduce a 504 when the batch size exceeded the streaming buffer threshold. Our notes / repro steps below: 

Repro steps (summary):
1) cURL used against https://us-west1.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings with API key header.
2) Payload: model=redwood-embed-xxl + 230300 docs, each ~23KB.
3) Observed 504 after ~30s while the server was still aggregating large KV state for reranker. Server logs show: 
   - "kv_cache_pressure: true"
   - "stream_timeout: exceeded"

Workarounds we validated:
- Chunking to <= 75 docs -> success consistently.
- Streaming embeddings (chunk & stream) -> success with lower memory usage.
- Increase request timeout to 60s as temporary mitigation.

Suggested action items:
- Try the SDK snippet Camila sent with chunk size 5075 and timeout 4560s.
- If you need higher throughput per request, we can offer a dedicated routing policy on Dedicated capacity to handle larger in-flight KV state (we can scope impact in a follow-up).

I'll schedule a 30-minute debug session (tentative: Wed 10am PT) 1 please confirm availability. Attaching a short repro script (repro_steps.sh) that mirrors the cURL we ran.

1 Neha

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>

Thanks team 1 quick update from our side. We tried Camila's snippet with chunking (chunks of 50) and increased the client timeout to 60s; the 5xxs stopped. We ran three full staging jobs and they all completed successfully.

We're good to proceed with the reranker PoC using the chunked approach. Please keep the debug session on Wed (we're confirming with our infra team). Also would like to explore Dedicated routing options if we expect to push larger single-request throughput in prod.

Next actions:
- Marissa: can you add this to the mutual action plan and share an updated timeline?
- Camila/Neha: please prep any notes on Dedicated routing options and estimated lead times if we choose to pursue.

Appreciate the quick help.

1 Alex
